The longer you're in ketosis the less accurate they will be. Your body will become more efficient at using and producing ketones and less will be lost in your urine. For now you are almost definitely in ketosis if the test says you are, but down the road they may test negative even if you are in ketosis. Newcomers to the diet often like the reassurance that they are in ketosis, but it's best not to get used to relying on them.

Full disclaimer though: I have never used these test strips myself so if anyone else has more familiarity with them I'd like to hear your experience too.

At first everything was good in the land of Digg. Funny cat pictures and youtubes were shared, tech blogs and cooking recipes were traded. But then, a few users decided that they knew better then everyone else. They said "We will decide what gets to the top and we will decide what the internet likes." But this wasn't so bad because a smart person could see when those users were brigading and could ignore them. Then those users so full of hubris and condescension said "We should be payed, we are advertisers, we are deciding what Digg likes and if you want Digg to like your product you will have to go through us." And the people of Digg grew unhappy. They did not like that they had to sift through such blatant ads to find funny cat pictures, and they did not like that these "power users" were deciding for them what they liked and what they said. So the people of Digg pleaded to the leaders of Digg.

And here, here is where Digg died, because the leaders of Digg instead of stopping the power users said "We will be the power users. We will hide the ads better then any power user could and we ill voat them up higher then any mountain. We will decide what Digg likes and we will control Diggs voice"

So the people of Digg left the country of Digg angry that someone had tried to control their voice searching for a new place where they could speak freely. They journeyed for many days until they came upon the Country of Reddit where they hoped they would find peace and interesting nerd humor and funny cat pictures for the rest of their days.
